dct_description_sm: On verso: Latin text ""India Orientalis"", pages 356-357, with signature ""Aaaaaaaa"".; Title appears in decorative cartouche.; Includes scale bars, cartouches, and illustrations of sailing ships and a sea monster.; Southern portion of Malay peninsula is shown as an island, separated from the rest of the peninsula by a large northeasterly channel.--From dealer description.; First published in 1606 in Hondius' expanded Dutch edition of the Mercator Atlas. This example comes from a French edition of the Mercator-Hondius Atlas.--From dealer description.
36 x 49 centimeters on sheet 46 x 57 centimeters
